input.answer: Ontario's CPI rent index (Rent, Ontario, not seasonally adjusted, 2002=100 base as published) rose from 161.2 in September 2025 to 164.4 in September 2026. The change is (164.4 − 161.2) / 161.2 × 100 = 3.2 / 161.2 × 100 ≈ 2.0%. The 2026-09 value is the latest in the table, so this is the complete period. Source: Statistics Canada Table 18-10-0004 (Consumer Price Index, monthly, not seasonally adjusted), vector 41691954.
